title: Humanity Created by God
definition: Humanity created by God means that every person owes their existence, identity, purpose, and accountability to the Creator.
summary: Human life is created by God and belongs to Him.
christFocus: Jesus, the eternal Son, is the One through whom all things were made and the One who restores fallen humanity.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that humanity is created by God. People are not self-made, self-owned, or purposeless. Life comes from the Creator and is lived before Him.

God made humanity with dignity, responsibility, relationship, and purpose. Human beings were created to know God, worship Him, reflect His character, steward creation, and live under His authority.

Sin distorts human identity, but it does not change the truth that people belong to God. In Christ, the purpose of humanity is restored as believers are reconciled to God and renewed in His image.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often try to define themselves apart from God. Humanity created by God matters because it gives a stable foundation for identity, dignity, purpose, and accountability.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive your life as a gift from God. Ask how your body, mind, relationships, work, suffering, and opportunities can be lived before Him with gratitude and obedience.
